opportunities.name: Ring Spellblade
opportunities.objective: Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack.
opportunities.mechanic: P grants extra attack range and AP magic damage after leaving its ring. Q tip slow and W movement/energy allow a return attack. Lich Bane adds a separate empowered attack, Nashor rewards actual attacks and Cosmic Drive helps ring traversal.
opportunities.requiredState: Exit and re-enter the ring with energy for the next spell.
opportunities.failure: Walking the ring loses spell uptime or exposes Akali.
opportunities.test: Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated casts do not guarantee repeated ready Spellblade procs.

opportunities.name: Shroud Ramp Return
opportunities.objective: Measure E2 and R2 success through a pressured shroud.
opportunities.mechanic: W lasts 5–7 seconds and R recasts after 2.5 seconds. Riftmaker ramps in champion combat and converts bonus health into AP; Rocketbelt gives access, Zhonya covers part of the wait, and E2 supplies most of E damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Maintain champion combat through W and R delay with E marked.
opportunities.failure: Disengage prevents ramp and stasis may miss E/R windows.
opportunities.test: Measure E2 and R2 success through a pressured shroud; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

ruledOut.reason: Q/E/R are explicitly magic despite AD ratios.

unknowns: Alternate passive records disagree on base breakpoints and 0.5 versus 0.55 AP; do not silently select the stronger record.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.
Unresolved conditional/runtime tooltip tokens prevent a complete numerical model; retained helpers do not establish live behavior.
Q summary calls its AD contribution bonus AD, while the symbolic Q calculation prints unqualified AD; verify that basis rather than resolving the conflict silently.

builds.name: Ring Spellblade
builds.summary: Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack.
builds.goal: Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack.
builds.hypothesis: P grants extra attack range and AP magic damage after leaving its ring. Q tip slow and W movement/energy allow a return attack. Lich Bane adds a separate empowered attack, Nashor rewards actual attacks and Cosmic Drive helps ring traversal.
testPlan: Required state: Exit and re-enter the ring with energy for the next spell.
Compare damage per completed ring-exit attack; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Walking the ring loses spell uptime or exposes Akali.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated casts do not guarantee repeated ready Spellblade procs.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
